items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Scope Clarification
items.Preferred Position: Define precise confidential information categories
items.Fallback 1: Use broad but defined terms
items.Fallback 2: Accept general categories with examples
items.Fallback 3: Allow for industry-specific exclusions
items.Red Line: No definition of confidential information
items.Deal Breaker: Confidentiality without definition

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Duration Specification
items.Preferred Position: Set term based on project lifecycle
items.Fallback 1: Use standard 2-5 year term
items.Fallback 2: Allow for automatic renewal
items.Fallback 3: Accept termination upon disclosure
items.Red Line: No defined term or expiration
items.Deal Breaker: Unlimited duration without termination clause

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Jurisdiction Selection
items.Preferred Position: Specify governing law and forum
items.Fallback 1: Use party's home jurisdiction
items.Fallback 2: Accept neutral jurisdiction with forum selection
items.Fallback 3: Allow for arbitration
items.Red Line: No jurisdiction or forum specified
items.Deal Breaker: Confidentiality without enforceable jurisdiction

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Remedies for Breach
items.Preferred Position: Include injunctive relief and damages
items.Fallback 1: Allow for specific performance
items.Fallback 2: Accept damages only
items.Fallback 3: Include punitive damages
items.Red Line: No remedies specified
items.Deal Breaker: No injunctive relief or damages

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Audit Rights
items.Preferred Position: Allow for reasonable audits with notice
items.Fallback 1: Accept audits with limited scope
items.Fallback 2: Allow for third-party audits
items.Fallback 3: Accept periodic self-audits
items.Red Line: No audit rights specified
items.Deal Breaker: No audit rights or procedures

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Notice Requirements
items.Preferred Position: Specify notice period and method
items.Fallback 1: Allow for reasonable notice
items.Fallback 2: Accept written notice only
items.Fallback 3: Allow for verbal notice
items.Red Line: No notice requirements specified
items.Deal Breaker: No notice period or method

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Assignment Clauses
items.Preferred Position: Require prior written consent for assignment
items.Fallback 1: Allow for assignment with notice
items.Fallback 2: Accept automatic assignment
items.Fallback 3: Allow for third-party assignment
items.Red Line: No assignment restrictions
items.Deal Breaker: Unrestricted assignment without consent

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Termination Rights
items.Preferred Position: Allow termination upon breach
items.Fallback 1: Accept termination for convenience
items.Fallback 2: Allow for mutual termination
items.Fallback 3: Accept unilateral termination
items.Red Line: No termination rights specified
items.Deal Breaker: No termination clause or rights

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Confidentiality Obligations
items.Preferred Position: Require obligations to last beyond agreement
items.Fallback 1: Allow for obligations during agreement
items.Fallback 2: Accept obligations for a limited period
items.Fallback 3: Allow for obligations upon request
items.Red Line: No confidentiality obligations
items.Deal Breaker: No enforceable confidentiality obligations

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Disclosure of Prior Agreements
items.Preferred Position: Require disclosure of prior NDAs
items.Fallback 1: Accept disclosure upon request
items.Fallback 2: Allow for limited disclosure
items.Fallback 3: Accept disclosure with exceptions
items.Red Line: No disclosure requirements
items.Deal Breaker: No disclosure of prior agreements

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Non-Compete Provisions
items.Preferred Position: Include non-compete with defined scope
items.Fallback 1: Allow for non-compete with notice
items.Fallback 2: Accept non-compete with exceptions
items.Fallback 3: Allow for non-compete with limitations
items.Red Line: No non-compete provisions
items.Deal Breaker: Unrestricted non-compete without scope

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Severability Clause
items.Preferred Position: Include severability clause for invalid provisions
items.Fallback 1: Allow for partial invalidity
items.Fallback 2: Accept renegotiation of invalid provisions
items.Fallback 3: Allow for continuation of remaining provisions
items.Red Line: No severability clause
items.Deal Breaker: No enforceable severability clause

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Integration Clause
items.Preferred Position: Include integration clause for entire agreement
items.Fallback 1: Allow for integration with prior agreements
items.Fallback 2: Accept integration with supplementary documents
items.Fallback 3: Allow for integration with terms and conditions
items.Red Line: No integration clause
items.Deal Breaker: No enforceable integration clause

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Entire Agreement Clause
items.Preferred Position: State agreement supersedes prior understandings
items.Fallback 1: Allow for prior agreements to remain valid
items.Fallback 2: Accept prior agreements with exceptions
items.Fallback 3: Allow for prior agreements with notice
items.Red Line: No entire agreement clause
items.Deal Breaker: No enforceable entire agreement clause

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Governing Law and Forum
items.Preferred Position: Specify governing law and forum
items.Fallback 1: Use party's home jurisdiction
items.Fallback 2: Accept neutral jurisdiction with forum selection
items.Fallback 3: Allow for arbitration
items.Red Line: No governing law or forum specified
items.Deal Breaker: Confidentiality without enforceable jurisdiction

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Dispute Resolution Mechanism
items.Preferred Position: Require mediation before arbitration
items.Fallback 1: Allow for direct arbitration
items.Fallback 2: Accept litigation as last resort
items.Fallback 3: Allow for third-party dispute resolution
items.Red Line: No dispute resolution mechanism
items.Deal Breaker: No dispute resolution or escalation path

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Force Majeure Clause
items.Preferred Position: Include force majeure with defined events
items.Fallback 1: Allow for force majeure with notice
items.Fallback 2: Accept force majeure with exceptions
items.Fallback 3: Allow for force majeure with limitations
items.Red Line: No force majeure clause
items.Deal Breaker: No enforceable force majeure clause

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Assignment and Sub-Assignment
items.Preferred Position: Require prior written consent for sub-assignment
items.Fallback 1: Allow for sub-assignment with notice
items.Fallback 2: Accept sub-assignment with exceptions
items.Fallback 3: Allow for sub-assignment with limitations
items.Red Line: No assignment or sub-assignment restrictions
items.Deal Breaker: Unrestricted assignment or sub-assignment

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Exculpatory Clauses
items.Preferred Position: Exclude liability for indirect damages
items.Fallback 1: Allow for exclusion of direct damages
items.Fallback 2: Accept exclusion of incidental damages
items.Fallback 3: Allow for exclusion of consequential damages
items.Red Line: No liability exclusion clause
items.Deal Breaker: No enforceable liability exclusion clause

items.Topic: Pre-Contract NDA Indemnification Provisions
items.Preferred Position: Require indemnification for breaches
items.Fallback 1: Allow for indemnification with notice
items.Fallback 2: Accept indemnification with exceptions
items.Fallback 3: Allow for indemnification with limitations
items.Red Line: No indemnification clause
items.Deal Breaker: No enforceable indemnification clause

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Renewal Terms
items.Preferred Position: Automatic renewal with 30-day notice period
items.Fallback 1: Renewal with 60-day notice period
items.Fallback 2: Renewal with 90-day notice period
items.Fallback 3: Renewal with 120-day notice period
items.Red Line: No renewal clause
items.Deal Breaker: Renewal with no notice period

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Termination for Cause
items.Preferred Position: Termination with 30-day notice period
items.Fallback 1: Termination with 60-day notice period
items.Fallback 2: Termination with 90-day notice period
items.Fallback 3: Termination with 120-day notice period
items.Red Line: No termination for cause clause
items.Deal Breaker: Termination with no notice period

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Confidentiality Period Extension
items.Preferred Position: Extension for 12 months after termination
items.Fallback 1: Extension for 9 months after termination
items.Fallback 2: Extension for 6 months after termination
items.Fallback 3: Extension for 3 months after termination
items.Red Line: No extension clause
items.Deal Breaker: Extension with no limit

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Data Protection Compliance
items.Preferred Position: Compliance with GDPR and CCPA standards
items.Fallback 1: Compliance with GDPR or CCPA standards
items.Fallback 2: Compliance with relevant data protection laws
items.Fallback 3: Compliance with industry-specific data standards
items.Red Line: No data protection clause
items.Deal Breaker: Non-compliance with data protection laws

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Payment Terms for Confidentiality Services
items.Preferred Position: Payment due within 30 days of service
items.Fallback 1: Payment due within 45 days of service
items.Fallback 2: Payment due within 60 days of service
items.Fallback 3: Payment due within 90 days of service
items.Red Line: No payment terms clause
items.Deal Breaker: Payment due with no deadline

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Audit Rights for Data Compliance
items.Preferred Position: Annual audit with 30 days' notice
items.Fallback 1: Annual audit with 60 days' notice
items.Fallback 2: Annual audit with 90 days' notice
items.Fallback 3: Annual audit with 120 days' notice
items.Red Line: No audit rights clause
items.Deal Breaker: Audit with no notice period

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Notice of Breach Mechanics
items.Preferred Position: Written notice within 10 days of discovery
items.Fallback 1: Written notice within 15 days of discovery
items.Fallback 2: Written notice within 30 days of discovery
items.Fallback 3: Written notice within 60 days of discovery
items.Red Line: No notice of breach clause
items.Deal Breaker: Notice with no deadline

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Remedies for Unauthorized Disclosure
items.Preferred Position: Injunction and damages for unauthorized disclosure
items.Fallback 1: Damages for unauthorized disclosure
items.Fallback 2: Injunction for unauthorized disclosure
items.Fallback 3: Injunction or damages for unauthorized disclosure
items.Red Line: No remedies for unauthorized disclosure
items.Deal Breaker: No injunction or damages for unauthorized disclosure

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Indemnification for Third-Party Claims
items.Preferred Position: Indemnification for third-party claims arising from breach
items.Fallback 1: Indemnification for third-party claims with caps
items.Fallback 2: Indemnification for third-party claims with limitations
items.Fallback 3: Indemnification for third-party claims with exclusions
items.Red Line: No indemnification clause
items.Deal Breaker: Indemnification with no coverage

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Force Majeure in Payment Obligations
items.Preferred Position: Payment obligations suspended during force majeure
items.Fallback 1: Payment obligations delayed during force majeure
items.Fallback 2: Payment obligations adjusted during force majeure
items.Fallback 3: Payment obligations subject to force majeure
items.Red Line: No force majeure clause
items.Deal Breaker: No suspension of payment obligations

items.Topic: Post-Contract NDA Assignment of Rights with Consent
items.Preferred Position: Assignment requires written consent from all parties
items.Fallback 1: Assignment requires notice to all parties
items.Fallback 2: Assignment requires reasonable notice to all parties
items.Fallback 3: Assignment requires notification to all parties
items.Red Line: No assignment clause
items.Deal Breaker: Assignment with no consent or notice

items.Fallback 2: Confidentiality for non-monetary information with limitations
items.Fallback 3: Confidentiality for non-monetary information with exclusions
items.Red Line: No confidentiality for non-monetary information
items.Deal Breaker: Confidentiality with no coverage

items.Topic: Data Subject Access Request Handling in NDA
items.Preferred Position: Define procedures for handling data subject access requests
items.Fallback 1: Outline data access protocols with timeframes
items.Fallback 2: Specify data retrieval methods and formats
items.Fallback 3: Include general data access guidelines
items.Red Line: Restrict data access without clear procedures
items.Deal Breaker: No data access protocols at all

items.Topic: Data Minimization in Confidentiality Obligations
items.Preferred Position: Limit disclosure to necessary data only
items.Fallback 1: Specify data categories to be shared
items.Fallback 2: Define data usage restrictions
items.Fallback 3: Include data categorization requirements
items.Red Line: Disclose unnecessary data without justification
items.Deal Breaker: No data minimization requirements

items.Topic: Data Retention and Deletion Protocols
items.Preferred Position: Establish clear data retention and deletion timelines
items.Fallback 1: Specify data retention periods by category
items.Fallback 2: Define data deletion verification processes
items.Fallback 3: Include data storage location requirements
items.Red Line: No data retention or deletion guidelines
items.Deal Breaker: Uncontrolled data retention without deletion obligations

items.Topic: Third-Party Data Processing Clauses
items.Preferred Position: Require third-party data processing agreements
items.Fallback 1: Specify third-party data handling standards
items.Fallback 2: Define third-party data security requirements
items.Fallback 3: Include third-party data audit rights
items.Red Line: No third-party data processing oversight
items.Deal Breaker: Unrestricted third-party data processing

items.Topic: Data Localization and Transfer Restrictions
items.Preferred Position: Limit data transfer to jurisdictions with adequate protections
items.Fallback 1: Specify data transfer compliance mechanisms
items.Fallback 2: Define data transfer security protocols
items.Fallback 3: Include data transfer notification requirements
items.Red Line: Unrestricted data transfer without safeguards
items.Deal Breaker: No data localization or transfer restrictions

items.Topic: Data Breach Notification Procedures
items.Preferred Position: Mandate timely data breach notification protocols
items.Fallback 1: Specify breach notification timelines
items.Fallback 2: Define breach notification content requirements
items.Fallback 3: Include breach notification channels
items.Red Line: No breach notification procedures in place
items.Deal Breaker: No data breach notification obligations

items.Topic: Data Protection Officer Designation
items.Preferred Position: Require designation of a data protection officer
items.Fallback 1: Specify data protection officer responsibilities
items.Fallback 2: Define data protection officer reporting lines
items.Fallback 3: Include data protection officer contact requirements
items.Red Line: No data protection officer designation
items.Deal Breaker: No data protection officer obligations

items.Topic: Data Subject Rights Enforcement Mechanisms
items.Preferred Position: Enable enforcement of data subject rights under the NDA
items.Fallback 1: Specify data subject rights enforcement timelines
items.Fallback 2: Define data subject rights enforcement procedures
items.Fallback 3: Include data subject rights enforcement channels
items.Red Line: No data subject rights enforcement provisions

playbook.name: escrow agreement management and enforcement playbook
playbook.description: Details the processes for managing and enforcing escrow agreements to ensure access to critical code and intellectual property.

items.Topic: Escrow agent selection criteria and due diligence
items.Preferred Position: Escrow agent must be a licensed and reputable financial institution
items.Fallback 1: Escrow agent must have experience in intellectual property escrow
items.Fallback 2: Escrow agent must have a track record of dispute resolution
items.Fallback 3: Escrow agent must be located in a jurisdiction with enforceable escrow laws
items.Red Line: Escrow agent is unlicensed or unregulated
items.Deal Breaker: Escrow agent is a competitor or has conflicts of interest

items.Topic: Escrow account funding requirements and timelines
items.Preferred Position: Funds must be deposited within 30 days of agreement execution
items.Fallback 1: Funds must be deposited within 60 days of agreement execution
items.Fallback 2: Funds must be deposited within 90 days of agreement execution
items.Fallback 3: Funds must be deposited within 120 days of agreement execution
items.Red Line: Funds are not deposited within 150 days of agreement execution
items.Deal Breaker: Funds are not deposited at all

items.Topic: Escrow release conditions and triggers
items.Preferred Position: Release occurs upon completion of all milestones and payment of fees
items.Fallback 1: Release occurs upon completion of all milestones or payment of fees
items.Fallback 2: Release occurs upon completion of key milestones or payment of fees
items.Fallback 3: Release occurs upon completion of major milestones or payment of fees
items.Red Line: Release occurs without meeting any conditions or payment of fees
items.Deal Breaker: Release occurs without any conditions or payment of fees

items.Topic: Escrow agreement review and approval process
items.Preferred Position: Agreement must be reviewed and approved by legal counsel within 10 business days
items.Fallback 1: Agreement must be reviewed and approved by legal counsel within 15 business days
items.Fallback 2: Agreement must be reviewed and approved by legal counsel within 20 business days
items.Fallback 3: Agreement must be reviewed and approved by legal counsel within 25 business days
items.Red Line: Agreement is not reviewed or approved by legal counsel within 30 business days
items.Deal Breaker: Agreement is not reviewed or approved by legal counsel

items.Topic: Escrow agent communication protocols
items.Preferred Position: Agent must provide weekly updates on escrow status and any issues
items.Fallback 1: Agent must provide biweekly updates on escrow status and any issues
items.Fallback 2: Agent must provide monthly updates on escrow status and any issues
items.Fallback 3: Agent must provide quarterly updates on escrow status and any issues
items.Red Line: Agent fails to provide updates for two consecutive months
items.Deal Breaker: Agent fails to provide updates for three consecutive months

items.Topic: Escrow dispute resolution procedures
items.Preferred Position: Disputes must be resolved through mediation before arbitration
items.Fallback 1: Disputes must be resolved through arbitration before litigation
items.Fallback 2: Disputes must be resolved through litigation if mediation fails
items.Fallback 3: Disputes must be resolved through negotiation before mediation
items.Red Line: Disputes are resolved through litigation without prior negotiation or mediation
items.Deal Breaker: Disputes are resolved through litigation without any prior attempts at resolution

items.Topic: Escrow audit and compliance requirements
items.Preferred Position: Agent must undergo annual audit by independent third party
items.Fallback 1: Agent must undergo biannual audit by independent third party
items.Fallback 2: Agent must undergo triannual audit by independent third party
items.Fallback 3: Agent must undergo quarterly audit by independent third party
items.Red Line: Agent fails to undergo audit for two consecutive years
items.Deal Breaker: Agent fails to undergo audit for three consecutive years

items.Topic: Escrow notice and disclosure obligations
items.Preferred Position: Agent must provide notice of any changes to escrow terms within 7 days
items.Fallback 1: Agent must provide notice of any changes to escrow terms within 14 days
items.Fallback 2: Agent must provide notice of any changes to escrow terms within 21 days
items.Fallback 3: Agent must provide notice of any changes to escrow terms within 28 days
items.Red Line: Agent fails to provide notice of any changes to escrow terms for 35 days
items.Deal Breaker: Agent fails to provide notice of any changes to escrow terms for 42 days

items.Topic: Escrow withdrawal and access rights
items.Preferred Position: Escrow funds can be withdrawn by both parties with mutual agreement
items.Fallback 1: Escrow funds can be withdrawn by either party with court approval
items.Fallback 2: Escrow funds can be withdrawn by either party with mediator approval
items.Fallback 3: Escrow funds can be withdrawn by either party with legal counsel approval
items.Red Line: Escrow funds are withdrawn without any approval or agreement
items.Deal Breaker: Escrow funds are withdrawn without any legal or contractual basis

items.Topic: Escrow agent liability and insurance requirements
items.Preferred Position: Agent must carry liability insurance covering up to $10 million
items.Fallback 1: Agent must carry liability insurance covering up to $5 million
items.Fallback 2: Agent must carry liability insurance covering up to $2 million
items.Fallback 3: Agent must carry liability insurance covering up to $1 million
items.Red Line: Agent has no liability insurance or coverage less than $500,000
items.Deal Breaker: Agent has no liability insurance or coverage

items.Topic: Escrow account management and reporting
items.Preferred Position: Agent must provide monthly account statements and transaction reports
items.Fallback 1: Agent must provide quarterly account statements and transaction reports
items.Fallback 2: Agent must provide semi-annual account statements and transaction reports
items.Fallback 3: Agent must provide annual account statements and transaction reports
items.Red Line: Agent fails to provide reports for two consecutive quarters
items.Deal Breaker: Agent fails to provide reports for three consecutive quarters

items.Topic: Escrow agent termination and replacement procedures
items.Preferred Position: Agent can be terminated by mutual agreement or breach of contract
items.Fallback 1: Agent can be terminated by either party with 30 days' notice
items.Fallback 2: Agent can be terminated by either party with 60 days' notice
items.Fallback 3: Agent can be terminated by either party with 90 days' notice
items.Red Line: Agent is terminated without prior notice or agreement
items.Deal Breaker: Agent is terminated without any legal or contractual basis

items.Topic: Escrow agent performance metrics and benchmarks
items.Preferred Position: Agent must maintain a 95% on-time release rate and 98% dispute resolution rate
items.Fallback 1: Agent must maintain an 85% on-time release rate and 90% dispute resolution rate
items.Fallback 2: Agent must maintain a 75% on-time release rate and 80% dispute resolution rate
items.Fallback 3: Agent must maintain a 65% on-time release rate and 70% dispute resolution rate
items.Red Line: Agent fails to meet any performance metrics for two consecutive quarters
items.Deal Breaker: Agent fails to meet any performance metrics for three consecutive quarters

items.Topic: Escrow agent data security and privacy standards
items.Preferred Position: Agent must comply with GDPR and ISO 27001 data security standards
items.Fallback 1: Agent must comply with ISO 27001 data security standards

items.Fallback 3: Agent must comply with basic data protection regulations
items.Red Line: Agent fails to comply with any data security or privacy standards
items.Deal Breaker: Agent fails to comply with any data security or privacy standards

items.Fallback 1: Agreement governed by laws of the State of New York and subject to its courts
items.Fallback 2: Agreement governed by laws of the State of California and subject to its courts
items.Fallback 3: Agreement governed by laws of the State of Texas and subject to its courts

items.Fallback 3: Agent must disclose conflicts of interest only if requested

items.Deal Breaker: Agent has conflicts of interest and fails to disclose them

items.Fallback 3: Agent must maintain a minimum credit rating of BB or higher

items.Deal Breaker: Agent has a credit rating below BB or is in financial distress

playbook.name: export control compliance audit playbook
playbook.description: Guides organizations through the process of conducting audits to ensure compliance with export control regulations and mitigate potential risks.

items.Topic: export control compliance audit playbook
items.Preferred Position: Conduct regular audits to ensure adherence to export control regulations
items.Fallback 1: Audit only high-risk transactions
items.Fallback 2: Audit based on internal risk assessment
items.Fallback 3: Audit only when required by regulatory bodies
items.Red Line: Audit findings indicate systemic non-compliance
items.Deal Breaker: Audit reveals intentional violations of export control laws

items.Topic: pre-contract export control due diligence
items.Preferred Position: Verify all parties' export control compliance status before signing contracts
items.Fallback 1: Conduct limited due diligence on key parties
items.Fallback 2: Verify compliance status of major parties only
items.Fallback 3: Conduct due diligence on a sample basis
items.Red Line: Identify parties with known export control violations
items.Deal Breaker: Parties with confirmed export control violations are involved

items.Topic: onboarding of foreign entities for export control
items.Preferred Position: Implement standardized onboarding procedures for all foreign entities
items.Fallback 1: Onboard foreign entities based on risk profile
items.Fallback 2: Onboard foreign entities with periodic checks
items.Fallback 3: Onboard foreign entities only when necessary
items.Red Line: Onboarding process fails to identify prohibited entities
items.Deal Breaker: Onboarding process allows prohibited entities to operate

items.Topic: export control risk assessment for new clients
items.Preferred Position: Perform comprehensive export control risk assessments for all new clients
items.Fallback 1: Assess export control risks based on client type
items.Fallback 2: Assess export control risks for high-risk clients only
items.Fallback 3: Assess export control risks on a case-by-case basis
items.Red Line: Risk assessment identifies significant compliance gaps
items.Deal Breaker: Risk assessment fails to detect prohibited client activities

items.Topic: export control training for employees
items.Preferred Position: Provide mandatory export control training to all relevant employees
items.Fallback 1: Train employees based on job role and risk exposure
items.Fallback 2: Train employees on high-risk export control topics
items.Fallback 3: Provide optional export control training sessions
items.Red Line: Training fails to cover critical export control procedures
items.Deal Breaker: Training is absent or not conducted at all

items.Topic: export control documentation review during onboarding
items.Preferred Position: Review all export control documentation during the onboarding process
items.Fallback 1: Review export control documentation for high-risk clients
items.Fallback 2: Review export control documentation on a sample basis
items.Fallback 3: Review export control documentation only when required
items.Red Line: Documentation reveals non-compliance with export control laws
items.Deal Breaker: Documentation is incomplete or falsified

items.Topic: export control compliance with OFAC sanctions
items.Preferred Position: Ensure all transactions are screened against OFAC sanctions lists
items.Fallback 1: Screen transactions against OFAC sanctions lists for high-risk clients
items.Fallback 2: Screen transactions against OFAC sanctions lists on a case-by-case basis
items.Fallback 3: Screen transactions against OFAC sanctions lists for major clients
items.Red Line: Transactions involve entities or individuals on OFAC sanctions lists
items.Deal Breaker: Transactions involve sanctioned entities or individuals without mitigation

items.Topic: export control compliance with EAR regulations
items.Preferred Position: Ensure all exports comply with the Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
items.Fallback 1: Comply with EAR regulations for high-risk products
items.Fallback 2: Comply with EAR regulations on a case-by-case basis
items.Fallback 3: Comply with EAR regulations for major exports only
items.Red Line: Exports violate EAR regulations without mitigation
items.Deal Breaker: Exports violate EAR regulations intentionally

items.Topic: export control compliance with ITAR regulations
items.Preferred Position: Ensure all exports comply with the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
items.Fallback 1: Comply with ITAR regulations for high-risk items
items.Fallback 2: Comply with ITAR regulations on a case-by-case basis
items.Fallback 3: Comply with ITAR regulations for major exports only
items.Red Line: Exports violate ITAR regulations without mitigation
items.Deal Breaker: Exports violate ITAR regulations intentionally

items.Topic: export control compliance with local regulations in foreign jurisdictions
items.Preferred Position: Ensure compliance with export control laws in all relevant foreign jurisdictions
items.Fallback 1: Comply with export control laws in high-risk jurisdictions
items.Fallback 2: Comply with export control laws in major jurisdictions only
items.Fallback 3: Comply with export control laws on a case-by-case basis
items.Red Line: Non-compliance with local export control laws is identified
items.Deal Breaker: Non-compliance with local export control laws is intentional

items.Topic: export control compliance with sector-specific regulations
items.Preferred Position: Ensure compliance with sector-specific export control regulations
items.Fallback 1: Comply with sector-specific regulations for high-risk sectors
items.Fallback 2: Comply with sector-specific regulations on a case-by-case basis
items.Fallback 3: Comply with sector-specific regulations for major sectors only
items.Red Line: Non-compliance with sector-specific regulations is identified
items.Deal Breaker: Non-compliance with sector-specific regulations is intentional

items.Topic: export control compliance with dual-use goods regulations
items.Preferred Position: Ensure all dual-use goods are exported in compliance with relevant regulations
items.Fallback 1: Comply with dual-use goods regulations for high-risk items
items.Fallback 2: Comply with dual-use goods regulations on a case-by-case basis
